required_rules.lifecycle: govern every real dispatch through a tensioned proposal, explicit human confirmation, deterministic registration, dependency-aware execution, complete closeout
required_rules.confirmation_readiness: Run the form owner's non-mutating confirmation-readiness validator against the exact temporary sheet.
required_rules.composite_readiness: Confirmation readiness is one composite checkpoint: form and version, live type-owner prerequisites, agent eligibility and identity uniqueness, final-approver admission, complete digest-owned tension evidence, configured publication boundaries, and any native runtime binding must all close before the human gate.
required_rules.tension_input_boundary: Run the configured tension gate against only the admitted sheet bytes and the gate rubric; companion files, parent summaries, and unstored chat context cannot satisfy the gate.
required_rules.confirmation_semantics: Silence, discussion, a question, or authorization to revise the draft is not dispatch confirmation.
required_rules.exact_sheet_invalidation: Any byte change, including mechanical reserialization, invalidates readiness, tension verdicts, and confirmation and returns the lifecycle to validation and explicit reconfirmation.
required_rules.execution_entry: Do not insert post-confirmation registration evidence into the closure-bound canonical dispatch.
required_rules.stage_handoff_readiness: A gate may return `needs_feedback` only with a typed defect, repair-owner stage, eligible already-confirmed edge, and remaining loop capacity; otherwise it returns `blocked`.
required_rules.human_gate: Human confirmation binds the exact admitted strategy sheet that was presented.
required_rules.private_boundary: Never copy private owner prose or paths into this public contract.

required_rules.owner: This adapter owns the DomainSpec constitution, type owners, form/schema, agent pool, registrar, ledger, Inventory policy, and local artifact paths.
required_rules.confirmation_readiness: Continue only when the command emits `SHEET_VALIDATION=pass`, `SCHEMA_VERSION=0.10.0`, the exact `SHEET_SHA256`, and `LEDGER_MUTATION=none`.
required_rules.preconfirmation_closure: For every schema 0.10.0 candidate, compile one `domainspec.preconfirmation-closure.v1` receipt after the tension branch is known and before asking for confirmation.
required_rules.experiment_lineage: For `experiment/run`, it also performs a bounded read-only ledger check and proves a resolved frozen proposal plus an identical current criterion ref; `LEDGER_READ=proposal_lineage_only` does not authorize mutation.
required_rules.composite_readiness: This is a composite readiness result, not merely syntax: the validator closes form/version, live type, agent-pool membership, non-null identity uniqueness, final-approver shape, complete pair coverage, and local path constraints.
required_rules.tension_input_boundary: Run the check-tension gate against the exact sheet bytes and rubric only: companion files, parent summaries, and unstored chat context are forbidden inputs.
required_rules.subject_group_predicate: A subject group has at least 2 agents and includes an `explorer`, `skeptic`, or `auditor`.
required_rules.no_subject_tension_disposition: A no-subject sheet spawns no tension agents and must carry exactly the canonical digest-bound checker/reviewer no-subject pair; a subject-group sheet retains two independent PASS verdicts, and explicit human confirmation remains mandatory in both branches.
required_rules.byte_revision_tension_refresh: Any strategist byte edit after admission invalidates the machine digest and returns to confirmation-readiness validation before the applicable tension disposition: fresh independent verdicts on the subject branch or a freshly derived canonical pair on the no-subject branch.
required_rules.confirmation_semantics: Silence, discussion, a question, or approval to revise the draft is not dispatch confirmation.
required_rules.human_gate: Human confirmation binds the reviewed material strategy, not raw sheet bytes.
required_rules.material_equivalence: Carry the prior confirmation only when they are equivalent, record a material-equivalence receipt, and attach that carried handle to the current digest at registration.
required_rules.profile_driven_registration: Use the canonical private runtime profile: preserve the durable material-bound source sheet, generate one run-local registration envelope after confirmation, consume only that envelope, and verify the normalized ledger row before execution.
required_rules.other_type_owner: The `other` LIVE type is owned by the bounded execution skill and requires explicit targets, mutations, validation, stop conditions, and independent downstream review for every mutating lane.
required_rules.approver_admission: Final approval: `final_approver` is `parent` unless it names the pooled sole `auditor` in a singleton dedicated approval group; arbitrary external names and working roles cannot approve.
required_rules.stage_handoff_readiness: The gate may instead return `needs_feedback` with a typed repair owner and one eligible already-confirmed edge, or `blocked`.
required_rules.public_private: Public/private boundary: when outputs land in public `arcanum`, do not write private parent paths, private submodule paths, emails, or workspace-only evidence into the public artifact.
